mapper.sql: request_id, asset_id, purpose, status, attempts, replay_generation, generation_attempts, last_failure, created_at, updated_at, next_attempt_at
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM asset_binding_release FORCE INDEX (idx_binding_release_status_created) WHERE status='PENDING' LIMIT 1001) p) AS pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM asset_binding_release FORCE INDEX (idx_binding_release_status_created) WHERE status='LEASED' LIMIT 1001) l) AS leased, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM asset_binding_release FORCE INDEX (idx_binding_release_status_created) WHERE status='DEAD' LIMIT 1001) d) AS dead, 1001 AS sample_limit, COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,created_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) FROM asset_binding_release FORCE INDEX (idx_binding_release_status_created) WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY created_at,request_id LIMIT 1),0) AS oldest_pending_age_seconds, COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,created_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) FROM asset_binding_release FORCE INDEX (idx_binding_release_status_created) WHERE status='DEAD' ORDER BY created_at,request_id LIMIT 1),0) AS oldest_dead_age_seconds, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AS observed_at
